description: Source code for FreeType PFR bitmap loader, including bitmap decoding, glyph bitmap loading, and related utilities.

methods.name: pfr_bitwriter_init
methods.description: Initializes a PFR_BitWriter structure with target bitmap and direction.

methods.name: pfr_bitwriter_decode_bytes
methods.description: Decodes bitmap data from bytes with packed bits.

methods.name: pfr_bitwriter_decode_rle1
methods.description: Decodes bitmap data using RLE1 compression.

methods.name: pfr_bitwriter_decode_rle2
methods.description: Decodes bitmap data using RLE2 compression.

methods.name: pfr_lookup_bitmap_data
methods.description: Performs binary search to locate bitmap data for a character code.

methods.name: pfr_load_bitmap_metrics
methods.description: Loads bitmap glyph metrics from data stream.

methods.name: pfr_load_bitmap_bits
methods.description: Loads bitmap bits into a FT_Bitmap structure based on format.

methods.name: pfr_slot_load_bitmap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap glyph into a glyph slot for a given size and glyph index.
